base-b.about: rhp as it is, a second bundle (A/A control)

leanguard.about: the guard's shorthands that expand to many longhands narrowed to the longhands that stop the page: animation-name, transition-property/delay/behavior, text-decoration-line

wheresplit.about: every :where(a, b, ...) guard rule written as :where(a), :where(b), ... (same specificity and protection)

emptyguard.about: the guard's inherit declarations skipped on empty blocks (:empty), everything else as before

trimguard.about: the guard split by element kind, without the resets that do nothing there, and with leanguard's narrowed shorthands

safetrim.about: trimguard keeping the inherit declarations on every element: only background on blocks that set their own, float/vertical-align off the body, and leanguard's shorthands

sel-labels.about: ::selection only on labels and axis numbers themselves, not on what is inside blocks

sel-inside.about: ::selection only on what is inside blocks and labels (the descendant half of the rule)
